scope: Complete identity mapping of the supplied parsed UI resources, plus audited non-UI functional paths. Mapping is not implementation or runtime equivalence.

families.title: About and license information
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Show XDM version, GPL license, dependencies and project links.

families.title: Main shell and category/queue navigation
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Task list and filters exist; full table/tree, menus, multi-selection and keyboard navigation remain.

families.title: Detailed progress and segment view
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Live HTTP totals/speed/ETA exist; connection visualization, resume capability and configurable detail tabs remain.

families.title: Tips and integration guidance
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Original help and tips must be replaced with independently written guidance and a dismiss/startup preference.

families.title: Add URL and download confirmation
families.behavior_and_acceptance: URL/path and queue import exist; category/description/auth fields, destination picker, history and download-later confirmation remain.

families.title: Download properties
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Details exist; editable destination/description, parent page/referrer, last-attempt metadata and address refresh remain.

families.title: Commercial registration and purchase
families.behavior_and_acceptance: XDM is GPL and has no paid activation. Map the information role to open-source license/project information; do not reproduce IDM license checks.

families.title: General settings and integration
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Browser opt-in exists; startup, clipboard monitoring, browser detection and integration preferences remain. D231 is an additional resource variant.

families.title: Proxy, SOCKS and advanced proxy settings
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Implement explicit none/system/PAC/manual choices, per-protocol credentials/bypass, SOCKS DNS and safe browser proxy context; native platform tests required.

families.title: Connection defaults
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Task connections and job limits exist; persistent default profiles and related settings UI remain.

families.title: Save paths and file dates
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Built-in routing exists; remembered/category/temp paths, creation-date policy and destination rules remain.

families.title: Updates and optional components
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Provide independent release checks and optional component handling with version/integrity validation; no IDM update endpoints.

families.title: Site/path credential profiles
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Origin/path-scoped credentials, protected storage and explicit edit/remove workflows are required.

families.title: Generic task confirmations
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Resource captions establish choices but not every caller. Trace triggering conditions before specifying yes-all/no-all or continue behavior.

families.title: Queue completion shutdown
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Explicit per-queue success/failure policy, cancelable countdown and OS adapter; fixture tests must never shut down the host.

families.title: Dial-up/VPN and redial
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Windows connection selection, credential handling and reconnect policy require native Windows validation; Linux equivalents need separate capability design.

families.title: Floating URL drop target
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Original visual design, drag/drop URL validation, show/hide and queue submission.

families.title: Download list export
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Portable JSON/text exports exist; selected/queue scope and original-format compatibility remain. JSON is an intentional new format.

families.title: Capture file types
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Hard-coded media detection exists; configurable extension types, defaults and site exclusions remain.

families.title: Usage quota and warning
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Persist byte budgets/window rules and warning/resume behavior, separately from speed caps.

families.title: Event sounds
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Per-event sound selection, preview playback and enable/disable preferences.

families.title: ZIP member preview
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Bounded range-aware archive inspection and a member list; unsupported/large/malformed archives need explicit handling.

families.title: Custom categories and rules
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Built-in extension/MIME categories exist; create/edit/delete, site patterns, custom folders and user overrides remain.

families.title: Language selection
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Independent translations, persistent locale and runtime switching; no copied IDM translation catalog.

families.title: Task columns
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Show/hide/reorder columns and persist widths/order; a row label is not column parity.

families.title: Per-server connection caps
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Host pattern limits shared across simultaneous tasks, distinct from per-task segment count.

families.title: Capture and select all page links
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Collect eligible links with selection, category/destination rules and durable batch handoff.

families.title: Force/bypass modifier keys
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Per-browser tested key combinations and transient capture override; no accidental default browser cancellation.

families.title: Connection diagnostics
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Bounded connectivity/integration checks and useful status without leaking authentication.

families.title: Problem reports
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Create a redacted, reviewable local report; sending must be an explicit user action.

families.title: Site grabber wizard
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Independent project wizard with crawl plan, destination, results and start/stop steps.

families.title: Grabber results and file filters
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Selection tree/table, duplicate rules, same-site restriction and filters.

families.title: Empty resource templates
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Retain identities; empty templates do not establish a separately reachable product feature.

families.title: Grabber filter editor
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Named wildcard include/exclude masks with add/edit/delete and validation.

families.title: Grabber project creation
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Project name, seed URL, templates and durable project state.

families.title: Grabber destination policy
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Category folder/single-folder rules, offline path mapping and conflict handling.

families.title: Grabber concurrency and cache settings
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Separate explore/download budgets; replace legacy IE cache behavior with a supported cache policy.

families.title: Crawl scope and depth
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Depth, base-site/outside-site limits, navigation filters, robots/rate policy and cycle bounds.

families.title: Grabber templates
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Named validated templates and independent settings schema.

families.title: Save grabber projects
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Atomic project save, name conflicts and optional prompt preference.

families.title: Load grabber projects
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Project listing, schema migration and damaged-project recovery.

families.title: Grabber statistics
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Processed pages/files, discovered links, filtered/skipped/error counts and progress events.

families.title: HTTP authentication challenge
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Realm/origin prompt, protected credentials, cancellation and retry; do not blindly forward credentials across origins.

families.title: Generated URL batches
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Numeric/alphabetic sequence ranges, padding, preview and bounded expansion. URL-list import is not generated-batch parity.

families.title: Grabber temporary-file cleanup
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Cancelable cleanup progress and interrupted-project recovery without deleting user outputs.

families.title: Grabber project schedule
families.behavior_and_acceptance: One-shot/recurring crawl/download phases, time limits and completion rules.

families.title: Completion dialog and actions
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Open/open-with/folder, dialog preference, destination action, app exit and explicit power policy.

families.title: Download defaults
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Explicit queue/paused import exists; start/complete prompts, eager transfer, duplicate defaults, User-Agent and completion options remain.

families.title: Queue completion restart
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Opt-in completion policy and cancelable restart countdown; native Windows/Linux tests required.

families.title: Chromium-family integration
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Linux Chrome for Testing handoff/fallback passes; installed Chrome/Edge/Brave profiles and native Windows registration/GUI validation remain.

families.title: Duplicate download choices
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Conflicts reject safely and explicit fresh-destination redownload exists; numbered duplicate/overwrite/resume-complete dialog policies remain.

families.title: Capture address/site exceptions
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Persistent site/address masks, cancellation prompts and once-only fallback behavior.

families.title: Handoff failure and browser fallback
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Real Linux acceptance/cancel and daemon-unavailable browser completion pass; single-use GET/POST, HTML miscapture, other platforms and disconnect/late-ack races remain.

families.title: Queue schedule
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Persistent global one-shot start/stop exists; per-queue times, recurring weekday/daily, time zones and missed-run policy remain.

families.title: Queue membership, order and concurrency
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Atomic stopped-task assignment, priority/FIFO and per-queue caps exist; manual ordering and sync retention remain.

families.title: Named queue management
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Create/rename/empty-delete/start/stop/limits and GUI filtering pass local tests; enabling a queue does not open the global gate, so independent original queue start semantics remain a parity gap. Stopping a queue interrupts only its workers.

families.title: Firefox browser adapter
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Independent event adapter, host registration and real browser tests; Chromium hooks cannot be assumed equivalent.

families.title: Speed limiter
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Persisted live HTTP task caps exist; application startup defaults, media caps and limiter-tab customization remain.

families.title: Task and optional file deletion
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Stopped-task removal preserves outputs/checkpoints and replay receipts; optional completed-file deletion and multi-task delete remain.

families.title: Floating player panel
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Full/mini player overlay, position/visibility, site exclusions and protected-content notification; toolbar popup is not overlay parity.

families.title: Privilege/integration compatibility
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Per-user IPC exists; Windows integrity levels, broker behavior and browser integration checks need native validation.

families.title: Stop waiting and reconnect UI
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Bounded retries exist; user-facing stop-waiting state and interrupted-read responsiveness need further tests.

families.title: Deferred tasks and queue choice
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Import paused/enqueue and queue assignment exist; per-download later/start queue prompt and remembered choices remain.

families.title: Selected-link download panel
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Selected URL detection, full/mini panel and always/never/site-specific preferences.

families.title: Exit and state saving
families.behavior_and_acceptance: SQLite persists commands and GUI can close independently; explicit whole-app stop/exit policy and graceful daemon shutdown remain.

families.title: Find file
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Case-insensitive URL/path/status/category search exists; description/page/referrer scopes, case/whole-string and find-next remain.

families.title: Minimum detected media size
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Configurable minimum size and unavailable-size behavior; do not discard manifests by segment size.

families.title: Antivirus hook
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Explicit scanner executable/arguments, completion timing and result/error handling.

families.title: Generic native New template
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Retain this framework-looking resource; caller and reachable product behavior have not been established.

families.title: URL and task list import
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Preview, safe names, atomic paused/queued import and restart receipts pass; source proprietary format compatibility remains separate.

families.title: Start/resume task
families.behavior_and_acceptance: HTTP pause/resume passes; manual Download Now bypass/preemption semantics and expired URL refresh remain.

families.title: Redownload task
families.behavior_and_acceptance: A new task at a fresh path inherits configuration; in-place overwrite/restart choice remains.

families.title: Pause/stop all
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Global stop checkpoints and requeues active tasks; distinct pause-all versus stop-all behavior needs original-product comparison.

families.title: Remove completed tasks
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Bulk completed-row removal and separate optional file deletion.

families.title: Find next
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Cycle search results with F3, wrapping and selection preservation.

families.title: Settings entrypoint
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Secondary controls exist; complete structured settings, validation and persistent defaults remain.

families.title: Category visibility
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Show/hide category navigation independently of the task table and persist preference.

families.title: Task sorting
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Sort by addition/name/size/status/ETA/rate/last attempt/description/path/referrer/page with stable tie handling.

families.title: Toolbar customization
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Button order/visibility, size and original XDM themes; no IDM toolbar assets.

families.title: Tray icon
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Show/hide, original icon choices, task/queue menu and background lifecycle on Linux/Windows.

families.title: Dark mode and fonts
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Persistent light/dark/system theme, font selection/reset and accessible contrast.

families.title: Help and project links
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Independent help/tutorials/queue/grabber chapters and project/support links.

families.title: Recent grabber projects
families.behavior_and_acceptance: Bounded recent-project list and missing-project handling.

families.title: Menu containers and separators
families.behavior_and_acceptance: A native menu bar with independently labeled commands; source hierarchy is evidence, not copied product assets.

non_ui_paths.title: HEAD/GET and actual Range probing
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: CLI fixtures verify real byte ranges and safe single-stream fallback; unusual compressed/redirected/unknown-size cases still need coverage.

non_ui_paths.title: Parallel range boundaries and response validation
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Unit split/range parsing plus hash fixtures pass. Server validators, identity encoding and declared byte bounds are checked.

non_ui_paths.title: Dynamic split and stalled-worker redistribution
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Lease-safe reassignment of the largest remaining segment, minimum split size and stall cancellation.

non_ui_paths.title: Checkpoint and crash recovery
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Segmented HTTP pause/resume and changed-validator refusal pass. The current single-stream path (including connections=1 on range-capable servers) restarts at zero and has no resume checkpoint; disk-full, forced crash, >4 GiB and filesystem edge cases remain.

non_ui_paths.title: Retry and error classification
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Transient retries and 403/malformed ranges pass; Retry-After/jitter, expired URL workflows and user-driven reconnect remain.

non_ui_paths.title: Sparse allocation, offset I/O and publication
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Pre-sized shared partial files and direct offset writes exist; native Windows sparse semantics and no-clobber completion races need more validation.

non_ui_paths.title: Headers, cookies and origin-scoped redirects
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Direct browser/CLI headers exist; cross-origin authenticated redirects stop. Protected credential storage and authenticated media replay remain.

non_ui_paths.title: Protocol and proxy coverage
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: HTTP(S) is implemented; FTP/PAC/SOCKS/profile fidelity from shipped settings requires independent work and native tests.

non_ui_paths.title: Aggregate bandwidth cap
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Requested XDM feature; distinguish aggregate global/host caps from IDM's observed per-file limiter.

non_ui_paths.title: Native Messaging framing and daemon bridge
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Partial framing/size tests, per-user local IPC and real Linux browser host handoff pass; native Windows ACL/integration validation remains.

non_ui_paths.title: Browser handoff transaction
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Durable registration before browser cancel and bounded fallback exist; late acceptance/timeout ownership reconciliation remains.

non_ui_paths.title: Link and media context menus
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Direct link/media actions exist; selected-link batches, modifiers and browser download-list context surfaces remain.

non_ui_paths.title: DOM and network media discovery
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: HTTP media elements, source children, MIME and URL candidates exist; player overlay, navigation lifecycle and all site variants remain.

non_ui_paths.title: Page-context XHR/fetch and manifest-body capture
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Original extension producers were mapped; fresh bounded page-context body/chunk/hash protocol is not implemented.

non_ui_paths.title: Available representation and audio catalog
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Public clear FFprobe tracks and popup selection work; compatibility/language/subtitle/audio-group details need broader fixtures.

non_ui_paths.title: Clear HLS selection and assembly
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: High/low video plus separate audio fixtures decode; authentication, live capture, discontinuities and expiring URLs remain.

non_ui_paths.title: Clear DASH selection and assembly
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Selected clear video/audio MP4 fixtures decode; additional profiles, subtitles and authenticated segments remain.

non_ui_paths.title: Mux and output format choices
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: FFmpeg stream-copy MP4 exists when codecs fit; MKV/WebM choices and explicit conversion remain.

non_ui_paths.title: Audio-only and MP3 extraction
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Explicit audio-only track workflow and optional MP3 transcode; MP4/MP3 are not interchangeable without conversion.

non_ui_paths.title: Protected-content handling
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Encrypted HLS and DASH ContentProtection refusal pass. DRM decryption is outside the requested clean-room scope; detection/notification fidelity remains.

non_ui_paths.title: Synchronization queues
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Retained source tasks, validator recheck intervals, changed-object replacement and sync scheduling.

non_ui_paths.title: Daily/weekday and periodic schedules
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Time-zone/DST, clock changes, missed-run policy, duration/quota cutoffs and durable execution IDs.

non_ui_paths.title: Completion program, sleep, exit and power actions
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Explicit per-queue policy, cancelable countdown, process launching and platform capability tests.

non_ui_paths.title: Browser host registration and packaging
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Linux/Windows registration scripts exist; native Windows browser profiles, installer, signing/update and file associations remain.

non_ui_paths.title: Windows monitor drivers and legacy IE helpers
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: No proprietary driver clone. Map download handoff to supported browser/native-host APIs; legacy-only compatibility is explicitly unverified.

non_ui_paths.title: CPU/RAM and native toolkit benchmark
non_ui_paths.behavior_and_acceptance: Bounded buffers and separate GUI/daemon exist; release PSS/private-byte, wakeup, 10k-row and Qt-versus-Slint measurements remain.
